sources.title: USB 3.2 Specification, bus power
sources.ref: A USB 3 unit load is 0.15 A. A host port supplies at least six unit loads, 0.9 A. V is 5. Ilimit is 0.9 A, that six-unit-load ceiling, for the same reason as the USB 2 preset: the USB-IF drop test loads a PC USB 3.2 host at 0.9 A and still requires VBUS of at least 4.75 V.

sources.title: Series resistance, assumed
sources.ref: Rs is 0.25 ohm, assumed. At 0.9 A the drop is 0.225 V, so the terminal is 4.775 V, inside the 4.75 V to 5.25 V window. The resistance that would sit on the 4.75 V floor is higher, and 0.25 ohm is the round value under it.
